t: What Health Emergency Resource Database Is All About
title: What Health Emergency Resource Database Is All About
description: Emergency care is a system: 911 dispatch, ambulances (8-minute urban target), trauma centers (Level I-IV), and referral routes moving patients up the chain. The 'golden hour' after trauma decides survival; stroke's 4.5-hour tPA window and heart attack's 90-minute door-to-balloon target are the timed contracts. Surge capacity — beds, staff, blood — must be planned before the disaster. This database is the complete emergency resource: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
